subtopics.title: How Mining Built and Still Carries South Africa

questions.question: Johannesburg leapt from farmland to the subcontinent's largest city because of:
options: The 1886 gold strike along the Witwatersrand

questions.question: The JSE belongs in the foundation evidence chain because it was created to:
Mining's outsized modern role lies chiefly in:
options: Export earnings that pay for imported oil, machinery and electronics

questions.question: Acid water from old workings, dump dust, sinkholes and stranded one-purpose towns belong in:

subtopics.title: The Platinum Case Study: Location and Favouring Factors

questions.question: South Africa's platinum lies in the:
The eastern limb of the platinum belt runs near:
The two thin platinum-bearing horizons the mines follow are:
options: The Merensky Reef and the UG2 chromitite layer
The Main Reef and the Kimberley Reef

questions.question: The market factor favouring platinum is:
options: World demand for autocatalysts, jewellery and hydrogen fuel cells

subtopics.title: Platinum's Contribution and Its Hindering Factors

questions.question: Within South African mining, the platinum industry stands out as the:
options: Largest direct employer, on the order of 170 000 workers

questions.question: Beneficiation means:
options: Exporting ore raw as quickly as possible
Processing ore locally to add value before export

questions.question: A PHYSICAL/TECHNICAL hindering factor for platinum mining is:
options: Metre-thin, deepening reefs that are hot, labour-intensive and hard to mechanise

questions.question: Battery electric vehicles threaten long-term platinum demand because they:
options: Use twice the platinum of petrol cars
Are all built in South Africa

subtopics.title: Mining on the Map: Identification, Grid References and Symbols

questions.question: Which cluster of map evidence points to mining activity?
options: Vineyard symbols beside a farm dam
A trigonometrical beacon on a hilltop
Straight-edged pale dumps, a dead-end rail spur and converging power lines
Green shading along a river course

questions.question: In a six-figure grid reference the correct order is:
options: Eastings first, then northings — along the corridor, then up the stairs

questions.question: On a topographic sheet, blue, green and brown respectively mark:
Asked WHY mining locates at a mapped platinum-belt site, your explanation should come from:
options: The map's scale and sheet number
The case study — the Bushveld's layered reefs, nearby infrastructure, labour and world demand

subtopics.title: The Country That Dug Itself Into Existence

questions.question: "Pull any thread of the modern economy backwards and it ends at a mine" refers to:
options: The railways, power grid, JSE and Johannesburg all growing to serve mining

questions.question: "Mining is South Africa's stall at the world's market" captures its role in:
options: Earning the foreign money that pays for imported petrol, phones and machinery

questions.question: A dying mine strands its town because the town:
options: Was built for one purpose and loses its reason to exist

subtopics.title: The Buried Saucer Full of Platinum

questions.question: In the saucer picture, the platinum-rich bands formed when:
options: Cooling molten rock settled its minerals into flat bands, like silt in a still dam

questions.question: The permanent pairing for the capital of platinum country is:
The four ingredients of the platinum superpower recipe are:
options: Cheap land, high rainfall, flat terrain, warm climate
Rich deposit, inherited deep-mining craft, next-door infrastructure, hungry world market

questions.question: "Extracting the jam layer from the middle of a giant cake" describes reefs that are:
options: About a metre thin and kilometres deep, so hard to mechanise

questions.question: Pale mounds with straight edges and perfectly square dams on a map are:
options: Mine dumps and slimes dams — shapes nature refuses to make

questions.question: A railway spur dead-ending at buildings in open veld suggests mining because:
options: Only trainloads of heavy, valuable rock justify rails to an isolated works

questions.question: "Along the corridor, then up the stairs" fixes the order of:
options: Easting then northing in a grid reference

questions.question: "Do not panic-memorise what the printed legend hands you for free" means:
options: The key is printed on the sheet — your job is speed, not recall
